manifest.selectionRule: all 110 Messier objects, plus the 140 brightest non-Messier NGC/IC deep-sky objects whose sourced V magnitude is <= 10.0, each verified against a second independent source inside its angular tolerance

simbad.label: SIMBAD (CDS, Strasbourg) TAP — basic / allfluxes / ident

vizier-bocl.label: VizieR B/ocl — Dias et al., optically visible open clusters

mwsc.title: Milky Way global survey of star clusters. II. (Kharchenko+, 2013)

cg20.title: Clusters in Gaia DR2 (Cantat-Gaudin & Anders, 2020)
cg20.field: cluster centre from Gaia DR2 members

hr23.title: A Gaia DR3-based catalogue of open clusters (Hunt & Reffert, 2023)

objects.name: Messier 102
objects.notes: M102 is the catalogue's one disputed entry: it was recorded by Mechain in 1781 and has never been certainly identified, and the two readings are that it is a duplicate observation of M101 or that it is NGC 5866. It ships once, with the uncertainty stated here, and is never silently duplicated or silently dropped.
